{{Quote|The galaxy is an estimated thirteen billion years old.|[[Crix Q5 Baobab]], teaching at the [[Baobab Merchant Marine Academy]]'s first day of orientation|<ref name="TEA" />}}
'''13,000,000,000 BBY''', or '''13,000,000,000 Before the Battle of Yavin''', was the approximate [[Standard year/Legends|year]] in which [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] believed that [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] was formed from dust and [[Gas/Legends|gas]]. [[Star system/Legends|Star systems]] and [[Planet/Legends|planets]] would form in the following [[Time/Legends|eons]] within the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], and life and [[Sentience/Legends|sentience]] eventually emerged on a portion of those worlds, leading to the events of the [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|galactic history]].

==The galaxy in 13,000,000,000 BBY==
{{Quote|This is our galaxy. Its luminous disk is about a hundred thousand light years across and contains some four hundred billion stars&mdash;only about a quarter of which have been thoroughly surveyed.|Crix Q5 Baobab, teaching at the Baobab Merchant Marine Academy's first day of orientation|<ref name="TEA" />}}
[[File:Galaxy1.png|thumb|left|250px|The galaxy that was formed in 13,000,000,000 BBY]]
13,000,000,000 BBY, or 13,000,000,000<ref name="TEA" /> Before the Battle of Yavin, was a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]]<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> that fell within the [[Pre-Republic era]].<ref name="Era" /> By that year,<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Universe/Legends|universe]] had already been created as a result of the event known as the [[Big Bang]].<ref name="SW1977-87">[[Star Wars (1977) 87|''Star Wars'' (1977) 87]]</ref> Many [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] later believed that, around 13,000,000,000 BBY, a [[Cloud/Legends|cloud]] of dust and [[Gas/Legends|gas]] one hundred thousand [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] across experienced a [[Gravity/Legends|gravitic]] collapse.<ref name="EGtAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> Eventually, the cloud coalesced to form a disk of the same dimensions&mdash;[[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]&mdash;that revolved around an extremely massive [[Galactic Center|black hole]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Impact==
{{Quote|What's that? Oh, you want an answer to the life question. Well, nobody knows for sure&mdash;remember only about a quarter of the galaxy has been properly surveyed. But there are more than five million intelligent species known to the Empire. Do the math and you'll realize there have to be a fair number of species we've yet to meet.|Crix Q5 Baobab, teaching at the Baobab Merchant Marine Academy's first day of orientation|<ref name="TEA" />}}
The [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] disk came to contain approximately four hundred billion [[Star/Legends|stars]], many of them developing over the succeeding [[Time/Legends|eons]] [[Planet/Legends|planets]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] them. By the time of the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="TEA" /> which [[Declaration of a New Order|began]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> much was known about the physical properties of the galaxy, but only around a quarter of all the galaxy's stars had been [[Scout/Legends|surveyed]] by that point. Based on mathematical statistics of the explored galaxy, it was estimated that approximately 3.2 billion [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] could support life and that one billion of those systems were inhabited by [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings. Despite approximately one quarter of the galaxy having been surveyed by that time, more than five million sentient species were known to the Empire, implying many more were yet to be encountered.<ref name="TEA" />

Since 13,000,000,000 BBY, multiple galaxy-spanning civilizations and [[Politics/Legends|political]] entities rose and fell, including the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]], the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Galactic Empire, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire]], the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], and [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]]. The reign of those factions was marked by a [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|series]] of galactic-scale conflicts.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Although the [[2001]] reference book [[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']] by [[Ann Margaret Lewis (real person)|Ann Margaret Lewis]] originally established [[5,000,000,000 BBY]] as the approximate date for the creation of the galaxy,<ref name="EGtAS" /> that date was eventually overridden by the [[2009]] book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which instead placed the galaxy's origin in 13,000,000,000 BBY.<ref name="TEA" />
